name: Talenti Dairy-Free Roman Raspberry Sorbetto (Smooth Strained)
whyItWorks: A 100% dairy-free, egg-free frozen dessert made from pureed and finely micro-strained raspberry fruit. Unlike fresh raspberries, all harsh woody seeds have been completely filtered out.
prepOrOrderInstructions: A refreshing, icy palate cleanser that satisfies berry cravings without dangerous seeds.
watchOuts: Contains natural raspberry tartness; avoid if sensitive to tart fruit acids during acute gastritis.
